description: genoa spec catalog — single discovery endpoint for all schemas, examples, and conformance tools. A cold-start LM fetches this document to discover all genoa resources in one call. Base URL: https://genoa.dev/v1/

manifest.v1.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for genoa.toml — image identity, agent runtime, capabilities, attestation policy, SBOM ref.

discovery.v1.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for GET /.well-known/genoa.json response — cold-start agent discovery endpoint.

attestation.v1.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for in-toto v1 Statement with predicateType 'https://genoa.dev/AgentHost/v1'.

capability.v1.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for a single capability declaration — extends MCP tool/list shape with provenance field.

manifest.description: Valid example genoa.toml manifest with 3 capabilities.

attestation.description: Valid example in-toto attestation with genoa AgentHost/v1 predicate.

probe.description: Nushell conformance probe. Run against a live host: `probe.nu run <hostname> [--level L1|L2|L3]`. Emits structured JSON pass/fail.

validate.description: Nushell schema validator. `validate.nu manifest <file>` | `validate.nu attestation <file>`. Emits {valid: bool, errors: [...]}.

genoa-v1.description: genoa v1 specification — Scope, Terminology, Manifest, Discovery, Attestation Envelope, Capability Declarations, Conformance Levels.

three_call_discovery.description: A cold LM discovers and validates a host in 3 calls:
three_call_discovery.call_1: GET https://genoa.dev/v1/catalog.json → this document. Discover all resource URLs.
three_call_discovery.call_2: GET schemas.manifest.v1.url → fetch the manifest schema to understand required fields.
three_call_discovery.call_3: nu validate.nu manifest <image-manifest.toml> → structured pass/fail conformance verdict.
